The main takeaway from our work is that

the physical act of turning the page on one’s past choices can help consumers feel satisfied with the decisions they have made, and that this effect is stronger when the decision process is difficult and when the decision is important.
consumers who have already chosen one alternative from a large set of options can benefit from taking a physical act of choice closure.
choice closure is a powerful and underexplored psychological process that can be used to improve consumers’ satisfaction.
